about_the_game:
The Dechala the Denied One DLC pack introduces the Slaaneshi champion as a playable Legendary Lord for Immortal Empires and Custom Battles. Starting in the Hidden Landing of the Cathayan Hinterlands, Dechala leads The Tormentors with a cruelly decadent and aggressively mobile playstyle.

For centuries, Dechala has waged an unending war of pain and pleasure. More Daemonic serpent than human, her sinuous body rises to a six-armed torso, each hand wielding a sword in a blur of killing strokes. Combining beauty and horror, she embodies Slaanesh’s essence, inspiring her followers to enforce her will with zeal and cruelty.

Unique mechanic: Pillars of Cruelty

Captured settlements convert into:

• Thrall Camp: generates Thralls and resources, though productivity wanes as they deplete.

• Tormentor’s Hold: enables recruitment, infrastructure, and defence.

• Pleasure Palace: Major Settlement option, requiring Thralls but granting advanced recruitment and economy buildings.

Unique mechanic: Decadence

Dechala’s actions raise Decadence, expanding Pleasure Palaces and unlocking powers. Benefits: Slaanesh boons (temporary buffs), Corruption of enemy units before battle, and Daemonic Attraction for instantly recruitable Daemons. She may also sacrifice Thralls for In Praise of Slaanesh, an area-damage ability summoning an enhanced Spawn of Slaanesh.

Unique mechanic: Tormentor’s Tributes

Through Decadence, Dechala selects powerful rewards:

• Marks of Vindictiveness: temporary battle buffs

• Opulent Gifts: unique ancillaries

• Exquisite Spoils: rituals with campaign benefits

New units

In addition to the standard Slaaneshi roster, Dechala commands:

• Legendary Lord: Dechala

• Lord: Chaos Sorcerer Lord of Slaanesh

• Legendary Hero: Strykaar of the Sortsvinaer

• Heroes: Druchii Anointed, Exalted Hero of Slaanesh

• Melee Cavalry: Pleasureseekers

• Melee Infantry: Devotees of Slaanesh

• Ranged Infantry: Devotees of Slaanesh (Crossbows)

• Monstrous Infantry: Champions of Slaanesh, Slaangors

• Monster: Preyton

• 3x Regiments of Renown

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: 3.4GHz Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD Ryzen CPU equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan, NVIDIA driver version 470.xx or later required (tested), AMD Mesa driver version 23.2.1 or later required (tested), Intel GPUs are not supported at the time of release
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: 3.4GHz Intel Core i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen CPU equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 8GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8GB
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan, NVIDIA driver version 470.xx or later required (tested), AMD Mesa driver version 23.2.1 or later required (tested), Intel GPUs are not supported at the time of release

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.5
  • Processor: Apple M1 (8‑Core CPU) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 (7‑Core GPU) or better
  • Additional Notes:
      The game is officially supported on all Mac models released since November 2020 with an Apple M1 chip or better. To check your Mac model and when it was released, select About This Mac from the Apple menu on your menu bar.
    ———
      The following Macs are capable of running the game but do not consistently meet the standards required for official support:
    • * All Mac models with an AMD GPU that support macOS 12.5
